svg.title: Two engines, one binary
svg.desc: What you ask (the CLI, Python, an MCP client for agents, an LSP client for editors) goes to two engines in one binary. Engine A, no index: no index, no parsers, no background process; walk, ignore rules, match, stream; it returns matches, grep, streamed. Engine B, the index: persistent, incremental, on disk; parse, symbols, call edges, text index, ranker; it returns ranked results (search), definitions and callers (symbol, callers) and references (refs). What comes back is marked with a highlighter.
svg.text: no index, no parsers, no background process
